tema: O vulto do milharal a narração faça em inglês
legenda: O milharal guardava algo muito pior do que a escuridão. O vulto seguiu Lucas até em casa e não vai embora tão cedo. 🌽 Você olharia pela janela ou se esconderia na cama? Comente sua escolha! #terror #suspense #historiasdeterror #creepypasta
falas: If I don't cross this dark cornfield before midnight, whatever is mimicking my brother's voice will catch me.
The dry stalks rustled violently behind me, even though there was not a single breath of wind tonight.
My flashlight beam flickered and revealed a tall, unnatural shadow standing completely motionless between the stalks.
It tilted its head with a sickening crack, whispering my deepest secret with an impossible grin.
I bolted in sheer panic as freezing cold breath brushed directly against the back of my neck.
Reaching the farm fence, I turned around and saw the creature wearing my brother's exact face.
Now it is tapping against my bedroom window—would you look outside or hide under the covers?
